issues.legal_issue: A statutory claim procedure cannot be declared obsolete and prospectively barred while the linked power to designate property remains operative and such designations remain possible.
material_facts: The High Court upheld concurrent findings that the disputed property was evacuee property and dismissed the claimants’ second appeal.
Despite dismissing the second appeal, the High Court declared the claim procedure obsolete and directed authorities not to entertain future applications under it.
The State appealed that declaration and direction.

The power to notify property as evacuee property remained operative, and a portion of the State remained under foreign control, leaving open the possibility that property could become evacuee property.
issues.conclusion: The Supreme Court held that the High Court had no need to decide whether the claim procedure had outlived its utility. Its observations and direction barring future applications were legally unsustainable and were set aside. The claim procedure had to remain available for genuinely affected parties while the linked property-notification power remained operative.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 6 and 8 of the Evacuee (Administration of Property) Act, 2006 of Jammu and Kashmir, the claim procedure in section 8 is closely interlinked with the Custodian’s power under section 6 to notify property as evacuee property. While that notification power remains relevant and operative, the claim procedure must be retained and available to genuinely affected parties. The Court cited no earlier cases.

predicates.appeal_challenges_prospective_claim_bar: A party appeals a court’s decision that prospectively bars authorities from receiving claims under a statutory procedure.
predicates.court_bars_future_claim_filings: A court directs authorities not to entertain future filings under a claim procedure.
predicates.designation_authority_remains_operable: The authority empowered to designate property in the relevant category retains operative power to do so.
predicates.future_property_designation_remains_poss: Circumstances remain in which property could later fall within the relevant designated category.

issues.definition: When an appeal challenges a court’s prospective bar on future claims and the linked designation power remains operative or future designations remain possible, the claim procedure must remain available to genuine claimants.
